concept.concept: A tote with a minimalist illustration of an overflowing bookshelf and the text 'I Have a Problem and I'm Not Fixing It'.
concept.audience: Book club members and bibliophiles aged 30-60
concept.rationale: Readers love carrying book-themed totes to libraries and bookstores. Self-deprecating humor about buying too many books is a beloved trope. Strong gifting potential in the fall season.

design.image_prompt: The design prominently features the text "I Have a Problem and I'm Not Fixing It" — spelled exactly, large and readable, integrated into the composition, no other words anywhere. Flat vector illustration of a minimalist wooden bookshelf overflowing with books. Books stack vertically and horizontally with some tilted and leaning at angles, a few volumes tumbling off the top shelf. Simple geometric shapes for book spines in solid colors. Clean bold outlines, no shading or texture. Centered composition with generous margin on a plain cream background. High contrast, screen-print aesthetic, solid color blocks only. Readable at 12x16 inches from across a room.
design.text_on_design: I Have a Problem and I'm Not Fixing It
design.style: Bold modern sans-serif, all caps, positioned in a single line below the bookshelf illustration. Heavy weight, clean letterforms, high contrast against the cream background.

verdict.reason: The phrase 'I Have a Problem and I'm Not Fixing It' is a generic humorous expression with no known trademark registration or association with a specific brand, celebrity, or IP holder. The minimalist bookshelf illustration is a common generic concept. The design references no protected characters, slogans, lyrics, or brand identities. This type of self-deprecating book-lover humor is widely used in the public domain of casual expression and presents minimal IP risk.

image_verdict.reason: Text reads exactly 'I HAVE A PROBLEM AND I'M NOT FIXING IT' — correctly spelled and complete. The illustration features a generic bookshelf with colorful books, a clean cream background, no IP concerns, no anatomy issues, and no rendering artifacts. Composition is clean and suitable for garment printing.

listing.title: Book Lovers Tote Bag 'I Have a Problem and I'm Not Fixing It'
listing.description: A witty tote for book club members and serious readers who know that overflowing bookshelves are a lifestyle, not a problem. Minimalist illustration of a bursting bookshelf pairs perfectly with the humorous message. Ideal for carrying library hauls, book club meetings, or as a gift for that special reader aged 30-60 in your life.
